summary: American Healthcare REIT filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to $1.75 billion of common stock, replacing a prior sales agreement under which roughly $1.58 billion had already been sold. Sales may occur at prevailing market prices, including NYSE transactions and block trades, through a syndicate of agents, with forward-sale structures available via affiliated forward purchasers. Shares closed at $56.04 on November 5, 2026. A 9.9% ownership limit supports REIT qualification. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and forward-sale settlement.
